benchmark: Hendrycks et al., Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset, NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks 2021
eligibility: All official levels 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5; original plain text questions excluding Asymptote/embedded graphics; filter only gold presentation, never model performance. Require exactly one explicit boxed answer in the published reference, whose contents form a signed decimal integer, optionally with correctly grouped thousands. Remove all occurrences of duplicate whitespace-normalized question text across all four source shards before allocation. Keep difficulty and subject labels. Samples are selected externally. Prior pilot task IDs are not implicitly removed.
scoring: Last explicit model box must contain an integer; normalize sign, leading zeros and well-formed comma separators; compare canonical exact strings. No float conversion, rounding, symbolic guessing or last-number fallback. A completed response with missing or malformed answer scores zero; a missing completion is unmeasured. Report subset and output rule alongside results; not a full MATH score.
private_scope: Only the scoring host may read archive shards, worked solutions and extracted gold. The Actor-facing API returns id, group, family, split, level and public prompt. Raw official test solutions are machine processed to authenticate format/score, never sent to Actor/Reviewer/Evolver; no evaluation outcome selects a task.
